meaning: A ministry lesson schedule URL is evidence of a timetable, not of the official textbook's complete lesson body, poem verses, dialogue or imagery. These links must never certify full subject completeness.

caveats: The title comparison covers 18 core first-term headings only, excluding workbook exercise records and term2

notes: Official course plan cannot be masqueraded as a textbook by documentType metadata
